# doctest

Vendored upstream `doctest.h` and `LICENSE.txt` from the **v2.4.12** release:
https://github.com/doctest/doctest/tree/v2.4.12

Used only by the host test executable. No network fetch is needed to configure
host tests, and doctest is not linked into production firmware.
